design_philosophy: A 'Friendly SaaS' approach. The agent dashboard leverages Archetype 4 for clarity, dense information hierarchy, and professional minimalism. The customer widget leans into Archetype 3 for approachability, using friendly rounded corners, vibrant blue accents, and subtle glassmorphism to emulate Intercom's welcoming feel.

agent_dashboard.left_sidebar: Border-r border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 flex flex-col h-full
agent_dashboard.right_sidebar: Border-l border-slate-200 bg-white flex flex-col h-full p-6 overflow-y-auto

customer_widget.launcher: w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-primary shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition-transform
customer_widget.container: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col border border-slate-100
customer_widget.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-primary/95 text-white p-4 flex items-center justify-between

chat_bubble.customer: bg-primary text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-4 py-3 max-w-[85%] shadow-sm
chat_bubble.agent: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm px-4 py-3 max-w-[85%]

input_area.input: w-full bg-slate-50 border-none focus:ring-0 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 resize-none max-h-32 text-sm

quick_reply.badge: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 cursor-pointer hover:bg-blue-100 transition-colors border border-blue-200

ai_suggestion.container: relative p-4 rounded-xl border border-transparent bg-clip-padding before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-z-10 before:rounded-xl before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-purple-500 before:to-blue-500 before:p-[1px]

motion.typing_indicator: flex space-x-1 items-center h-4; dots: w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-slate-400 rounded-full animate-bounce

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on primary blue meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for all icon buttons (attachments, send, close widget).

agent_avatar.description: Professional female support agent portrait, used for agent dashboard profile and widget header.

customer_avatar.description: Smiling male customer portrait, used in agent dashboard for active chat customer profile.

brand_logo.description: Abstract technology logo, used in the Admin and Dashboard headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure Tailwind CSS for structural layouts (Dashboard grid, Widget absolute positioning).
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions: DropdownMenu for agent status, Tabs for switching views in Admin, Dialog for settings.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='chat-launcher', data-testid='send-message-btn').
Implement real-time typing indicator with CSS animations.
Ensure the chat widget launcher is a rounded button with a primary color background and a smiling chat icon.
The AI suggestion block should have a subtle gradient border using the 'ai_suggestion' class setup to visually distinguish it as AI-generated.
